description.value: Maenam is Chef Angus' flagship Thai restaurant at 1938 West 4th Avenue in Vancouver's Kitsilano neighbourhood, open since 2009, blending intensely flavourful Thai ingredients with seasonal BC seafood, meats, and locally sourced produce. It has been repeatedly named one of Canada's 100 Best Restaurants, won Vancouver magazine's Restaurant of the Year in 2016, and earned a place in MICHELIN's inaugural Vancouver Guide. The multi-course family-style sharing format and rotating seasonal menu make it one of Vancouver's most celebrated dining destinations.
